description.en: The ID of the file system.

description.zh:
指定目录的绝对路径。

必须以正斜线（/）开头，并且是挂载点中真实存在的路径。
description.en:
The absolute path of the directory or file.

The path must start with a forward slash (/) and must be an existing path in the mount target.
